create_datetime_truncate: truncate datetime values to bucket boundaries using a string interval like '1h' or '1d'
create_datetime_round: round datetime values to the nearest bucket boundary using a string interval like '1h' or '30m'
create_datetime_offset_by: offset dates or datetimes by a relative time string such as '1mo' or '-1y2mo'
create_datetime_to_string: convert date or datetime columns to formatted string columns using strftime format specifiers
create_datetime_extract_components: extract year month day hour minute second components from date or datetime expressions
